days.title: 바나힐 – 골든 브리지
days.morning: Take the cable car up Ba Na and visit the Golden Bridge early.
days.afternoon: French Village, Le Jardin flower garden and Fantasy Park.
days.evening: Back down for mì Quảng and seaside seafood.

days.title: 선짜 – 오행산
days.morning: Swim at My Khe and visit Linh Ung Pagoda on Son Tra.
days.afternoon: Marble Mountains and Non Nuoc stone village.
days.evening: Watch the Dragon Bridge breathe fire (weekend evenings) and Son Tra night market.

days.title: 하이반 고개
days.morning: Ride the Hai Van pass by motorbike and stop in Lang Co.
days.afternoon: Pork rolled in rice paper and coffee overlooking the Han river.
days.evening: Han river cruise as the city lights up.

days.title: 호이안 구시가지
days.morning: Head to Hoi An: Tra Que vegetable village and Bay Mau coconut forest.
days.afternoon: The Covered Bridge, Fujian Assembly Hall and Tan Ky house.
days.evening: Release lanterns on the Hoai river and eat cao lầu.

days.title: 꾸라오짬 섬
days.morning: Speedboat to Cu Lao Cham for snorkelling.
days.afternoon: Swim at Chong beach and visit Bai Lang fishing village.
days.evening: Back in Da Nang, buy beef sausage and dried squid as gifts.
